newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cisco started outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cisco started outperform.

text.p: -- Oppenheimer & Co started coverage of Cisco Systems Inc on Tuesday with an outperform rating on Tuesday.
-- Analyst Randall Yuen said he gave the stock an $80 a share price target.

-- Yuen said "Cisco is well-positioned, although there are some possible risks with the story having to do with alternative technologies such as IP switching and fast IP," but he said Cisco should be able to withstand the new technologies.
-- IP switches allow computers to network using a single protocol, the IP system.
